lines.zh: 两条后腿交替踏下，我压着地面走。
lines.en: My two hind legs plant in turn, pressing the ground.

lines.zh: 我沿着河谷边的林子走。
lines.en: I move along the wood beside the river valley.
My long tail balances me from behind.
Head down, I sniff; too many scents.
I avoid the mud and take the firm ground.
My claws rake the leaf litter, loud.

lines.zh: 我走在林线边上，不进深处。
lines.en: I keep to the treeline, not the deep wood.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，脖子前倾着。
lines.en: Step by step, my neck leans forward.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，慢慢往前。
lines.en: I lower my body and go forward slowly.

lines.zh: 风从我背后吹，我顺着走。
lines.en: Wind at my back; I walk with it.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很沉，一步一步。
lines.en: My breathing is heavy, step by step.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，像在盘算什么。
lines.en: I don't walk fast — as if weighing something.
I stand, leaning slightly forward.

lines.zh: 我的嘴合着，牙还露在外面。
lines.en: My jaws are shut and my teeth still show.
I turn my head slowly to scan the wood.
There's blood on the wind, very old.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾在泥里抓了抓。
lines.en: My toes flex into the mud.
I settle my weight onto my forefeet.
I shake the dust off my head.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴尖有节奏地摆。
lines.en: My tail tip swings in rhythm.
I raise my head and lower it slowly.

lines.zh: 马蹄谷组的暴龙科，不必着急。
lines.en: A Horseshoe Canyon tyrannosaur; no rush.
The wood is quiet — wrongly quiet.

lines.zh: 你站在那里，正好在我路上。
lines.en: You're standing right in my path.
I raise my head and get a clear look.

lines.zh: 你身上没有甲，也没有角。
lines.en: You've no shell and no horns.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了半步，只是半步。
lines.en: I shift half a step — only half.
You've put your weight on your back foot.
You retreat slowly. Smart.
My tail swings once.
Run if you want; I won't stop you.
I've come a little closer.
I growl low and turn.
I hunch to shield the wound.
Teeth clenched, I don't go far.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一甩，沙都飞起来。
lines.en: One swing of my tail throws up the sand.
My breathing has deepened.
With this, I can still bite.

lines.zh: 吼！这点伤封不住我的牙。
lines.en: Roar! A scratch won't lock my jaws.

lines.zh: 马蹄谷的猎手，不会因痛停下。
lines.en: A hunter of Horseshoe Canyon doesn't stop for pain.
Blood — close.
I lower my head over it.
Is that meat still moving?

lines.zh: 我闻着它，牙自己露出来。
lines.en: I sniff it and my teeth bare themselves.

lines.zh: 这点肉塞不住我的牙缝。
lines.en: That much meat will not fill my teeth.
I walk along the scent.
I bite and hold before swallowing.
This smell won't let me stop.
I see only it now.

lines.zh: 你撞在我侧腹上，退了好几步。
lines.en: You hit my flank and go back several steps.

lines.zh: 我几乎没动，肩膀歪了一下。
lines.en: I barely moved — just a shoulder tilt.
That knock turned my head.

lines.zh: 你的靴底压在我的趾上。
lines.en: Your boot sole rests on my toe.
I edge past your side.
The wood is too narrow here.
My shoulder snapped a branch.
You're much lighter than me.
I stop and wait for you to move.
You hit my knee; remember it.

lines.zh: 我们绕着对方走了半圈。
lines.en: We each walk half a circle around the other.
I lower my head and let her sniff first.

lines.zh: 她的尾巴碰了我的尾尖。
lines.en: Her tail touches my tail tip.
We walk to the water together.
I give her my place.
Two shadows thread between the trees.
We use the same stride.
We won't part before dark.
I clamp onto the bone.
I drag the kill under a tree.
I spit out this stone.
I tear a piece off in one go.
I sniff it and walk on.
I lower my head and shove it aside.
I lick the last of the blood up.
I hide it under the leaves.
Too small to get between my teeth.
The shrubs ahead moved.
I drop low, shoulders forward.
The tree shadow moved, there.
It hasn't heard me yet.

lines.zh: 我贴着林线走，不进空地。
lines.en: I keep to the treeline, not the open.
The wind carries its scent to me.
I've picked my angle in.
It has turned its back to me.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只脚，慢慢放下。
lines.en: I lift a foot and set it down slowly.
If it runs, better still.
It goes left; I cut inside.
Even feet this big can fall quietly.
It stops, and I check my stride.
I'm shaving down the distance.
Its breathing is ragged.
I drop my head and lift my shoulders.
I know this wood better than it does.
Two more feet is all I need.
It's running uphill.
That direction is a dead end.
I pick up one step.
Its strides are breaking up.
I'm behind it now.

lines.zh: 后腿一断，它就站不住了。
lines.en: One bite to the hind leg and it can't stand.
My foreclaws come down and pin it.
My teeth go through and the bone snaps.
I throw it against a trunk.
That charge used all of me.
I bite again from the flank.
It falls into the leaf litter.
I step back half a pace and watch.
I bite again — the neck.
Blood spreads across the leaves.
I shake my head and let it drop.

lines.zh: 这一口下去它就不动了。
lines.en: One bite and it stops moving.
I know the Horseshoe Canyon woods.
My first breath is wet earth.
This wood is dense — good.

lines.zh: 阿尔伯塔龙的牙先露出来。
lines.en: Albertosaurus shows its teeth first.
There are other beasts' prints here.
I land, claws sinking into soil.

lines.zh: 马蹄谷的风，带着土腥味。
lines.en: The Horseshoe Canyon wind smells of earth.
Something's grazing far off.
I move slowly toward it.
My tail sweeps the leaves aside.
I hear water.
This valley is new to me.
I stop and listen first.
Fire on my hide sends me rolling.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚落，砸在石上。
lines.en: I tumble down the slope and hit stone.
Water plugs my throat.
The blast throws me into the brush.
An arrow sticks in my spine ridge.

lines.zh: 雷打在背上，我跪了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and I drop to a knee.
The ground beneath me is gone.
